chunks: And the Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Aban, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Nadr, from Ya'qub ibn Yaqtin, from Abi al-Hasan عليه السلام, who said:
The minimum of menstruation is three, and its maximum is ten.

key_terms.أَدْنَى: the minimum limit or lowest valid duration
key_terms.أَقْصَاهُ: its furthest limit or maximum duration
key_terms.الْحَيْضِ: menstruation, referring here to the legally recognized menstrual bleeding
key_terms.ثَلَاثَةٌ: three days, the minimum duration mentioned for hayd
key_terms.عَشَرَةٌ: ten days, the maximum duration mentioned for hayd

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum and maximum duration of menstruation in Shi'i hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding the minimum and maximum duration of hayd (menstruation). It is significant in Shi'i fiqh for determining related rulings of taharah (ritual purity), salat (prayer), and other devotional obligations.
